question: Which profiles and permission sets may run this Apex class?

steps.name: cls
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Name FROM ApexClass WHERE Name = '{name}'

steps.name: grants
steps.soql: SELECT Parent.Name, Parent.IsOwnedByProfile, Parent.Profile.Name FROM SetupEntityAccess WHERE SetupEntityId IN ({@cls.Id}) ORDER BY Parent.Name

verdicts.say: {name} exists but no profile or permission set grants it.

traps: Class access matters for Apex called from the UI (Aura, LWC, Visualforce); triggers and system-context calls ignore it.
